limitationTriage.reasonOpen: about 100 CPU-hours, plus an engine change and renewed checking; sharper bounds (larger centralisers) could reduce it

limitationTriage.limitation: Pole bounds exceed the truth by exactly 2 at a few small orders
limitationTriage.closingQuestion: Does the centraliser Z_G(t) (Derksen Prop. 3.3 / proof of Thm 3.4) explain the excess (editorial gate DOM-3)?
limitationTriage.triedOrSearched: implemented and tested (scripts/centraliser_bounds.py, paper Remark 9): valid for d = 5..9, never below the true multiplicities; removes the excess only at r = 2 for d = 5, 7, 8. The remaining maxima come from level sets of regular torus elements (centraliser T).
limitationTriage.estimatedCost: about 1 h (done); a full explanation is not known
limitationTriage.reasonOpen: centralisers explain only r = 2; the rest needs a new idea
limitationTriage.whyNotClosedNow: the cheap route was tried and recorded as a partial negative result
